g.title: j2260890776
g.text: Hey Lettie? Are you busy? [Ask consent for multiple partners.]

g.title: j2543291252
g.text: I want to talk to you about something and I want to make sure you're okay with it.

g.title: j2828537693
g.text: It's important to me that you don't feel like I'm lying to you or being dishonest with you in any way.

g.title: j2245753515
g.text: I only hurt you the way you like it
Now what are you going on about

g.title: j2912372864
g.text: And what is there to get mad about?

g.title: j2034947476
g.text: And what is there to understand?

g.title: j3120189448
g.text: I don't want to put you into a situation you're not okay with. I know it's not something we've discussed before. So if you say no, that's all right. I want you to know that.

g.title: j2523507220
g.text: What we have is important to me - very important - and it's real. I don't want you to doubt that.

g.title: j2963158745
g.text: I guess I just want to know
Do you really care about them, solecito?

g.title: j4127617655
g.text: I do care about them. But I also care very deeply about you.

g.title: j368951085
g.text: I should have guessed you would have figured it out quickly.

g.title: j1205014383
g.text: Hard to blame you, when you see so much

g.title: j69528271
g.text: Jajaja she is a terrible gossip

g.title: j4109969723
g.text: I would have to scrub myself with prep pads for a week

g.title: j1876609086
g.text: Hard to blame you, when you see so much

g.title: j40193082
g.text: You have become very important to me, solecito
And if they bring you happiness?
Then they bring me the same

g.title: j1825455531
g.text: And find a way to bring them here someday

g.title: j4057902789
g.text: I'll see what I can do.
